scheme_name: Marriage Assistance to Person with Disability / BPL
other_conditions: Disability certificate showing at least 40% disability is required
Valid ration card must be presented
Family income certificate must be certified by the Deputy Commissioner or Sub‑Divisional Officer of the island
Applicant must not have availed any similar scheme benefit from State/Central Government or any other agency
Beneficiary may marry either a differently‑abled person or a non‑disabled person, but it must be the first marriage for both individuals
Application must be made within 30 days of marriage and can be claimed up to one year after marriage
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance of ₹30,000 transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account for the first marriage of a differently‑abled BPL individual.
